title: The Open Landfall
premise: Dominic Delacroix has spent a decade outrunning her mother's legend, digging other people's sites and pocketing just enough to stay ahead of a debt she never explains. When rival archaeologist Ivo Marchetti hires her crew to chart the river route to the forbidden source of the Sombra—a site her mother died trying to reach—Dominic agrees for the money and stays for the truth. As monsoon clouds gather, she must choose between protecting the crew she's come to love as family and the discovery that could finally make her belong somewhere. In the end, she reaches the source, buries her mother's compass there instead of claiming the find, and returns downstream to build a life that is hers rather than an inheritance.
about_author: Ansel Sandoval is a former river guide who spent six seasons on the waterways of Southeast Asia before turning to fiction. He writes adventure stories about people who are better at surviving than at staying.

chapters.title: The Debt in the Dirt
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Working a salvage dig in a coastal town, Dominic is tracked down by Ivo Marchetti with an offer: lead his crew upriver to the Sombra source, the expedition her mother swore off and died chasing anyway. The money clears her debt; the name on the contract is a wound reopened. Emotional beat: reluctant acceptance—the past knocking with a price attached.

chapters.title: Upstream of Every Map
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, with interludes from crewmate Rhea's journal. The crew pushes upriver through villages that remember her mother's last expedition, and Dominic realizes Ivo is following her mother's stolen field notes, not his own research. Tensions flare when Rhea discovers Dominic knew the route all along. Emotional beat: trust fraying under the weight of secrets.

chapters.title: What the Monsoon Keeps
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. First storm bands hit; a rope bridge fails and Ivo, exposed as willing to sacrifice the crew for the claim, strands them above the flood line. Dominic leads a night descent through rising water, choosing the crew over the prize, and finds the source cave marked in her mother's hand. Emotional beat: climax—love against duty, made literal in the rain.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, closing with Rhea's journal. At the source, Dominic reads her mother's final notes—an apology, not a map—and leaves the compass buried where it belongs, letting the monsoon seal the site. She negotiates Ivo's silence with evidence of his sabotage and walks out beside her crew. Emotional beat: resolution—belonging chosen, not inherited.
